intent_0000380v0879x1qrpeygtbas6g.statement: Codex users can complete traceable, spec-driven coding sprints with evidence-based QA across sessions
intent_0000380v0879x1qrpeygtbas6g.rationale: Prevent intent loss, fragmented implementation, false completion, and secret exposure

intent_0000380v1bjszxx5fvyqj97dbc.statement: Archived sprints retain verifiable reports and QA evidence
intent_0000380v1bjszxx5fvyqj97dbc.rationale: Historical evidence must survive document relocation

intent_0000380v2edshbndyv7s262qx4.statement: Codex can explain implementation structure and verify intent-driven UX and data journeys with capability-aware evidence
intent_0000380v2edshbndyv7s262qx4.rationale: Resolve WP-08 and WP-10 carry items without overclaiming unavailable semantic or runtime observations

ac_0000380v0879w5hd6ycx9d30a4.statement: Invalid lifecycle transitions are rejected by deterministic guards

ac_0000380v08877q99z5dhgbmy94.statement: Workflow context persists and resumes from repository state

ac_0000380v088rk9asvj58k5yas4.observable: plugin and skill validators pass and init creates five agent profiles

ac_0000380v089nzm9x13h1ve950m.statement: Secret-dependent commands preserve the tene security boundary

ac_0000380v1bjsysc9vr2c1hxq7c.statement: Archive updates all persisted locators and writes an archive manifest
ac_0000380v1bjsysc9vr2c1hxq7c.observable: archive test finds the manifest and every evidence URI under the archive root

ac_0000380v1bkekw07vvg8r3yzd8.statement: Archived evidence remains verifiable without an active sprint
ac_0000380v1bkekw07vvg8r3yzd8.observable: evidence verify and doctor pass after archive

ac_0000380v2edshngbm3j48f7hq0.statement: Code analysis materializes Understanding Layers and Six Questions with provenance and explicit unknowns

ac_0000380v2f3bsngnt2b92sq9w4.statement: QA planning discovers execution capabilities and binds external UX and data observations to cases as verified evidence
